title: Tickle the Ghost
body:
Goal: use if-else with a sensing question inside forever. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project: File > New.
  2. Delete the cat: right-click it in the sprite pane and choose delete.
  3. Click Choose a Sprite and pick Ghost (or any sprite you like).
  4. Build the script below. if ... then ... else and forever are in Control. The pointy touching (mouse-pointer)? block is in Sensing. set size to and say are in Looks.
  5. For the last say, delete the text so the box is empty.
  6. Click the flag. Move your mouse over the ghost, then away.
  7. Predict, then test: what happens if you take away the forever? Put it back.
  8. Save as tickle-ghost.

The script in words

Ghost sprite:

  • when green flag clicked
  • forever:
    • if touching mouse-pointer? then
      • set size to 150 %
      • say "Boo! That tickles!"
    • else
      • set size to 100 %
      • say "" (empty)

Expected behavior

After the green flag, whenever the mouse pointer touches the ghost, it grows bigger and says "Boo! That tickles!". When the mouse moves away, it goes back to normal size and the speech bubble disappears. Without forever, nothing happens, because the question is asked only once.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: The ghost must keep asking one question again and again: is the mouse touching me? Look for a loop in the Control category that never stops. The question block with pointy ends is in the Sensing category.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Use an if ... then ... else block from Control, and put it inside forever. The top part runs when the answer is yes. The else part runs when the answer is no. Both parts need a size and a say.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Drop touching ( mouse-pointer )? from Sensing into the if hole. Put set size to ( ) % and say ( ) in each part. The two parts need different numbers. In the else part, leave the say box empty so the bubble disappears.
